summary: PriceFlash mobile app fully tested - Backend (14/14) and Frontend (All flows) passing. All features working correctly with mock data integration.
critical_code_review_comments: ✓ All interactive elements have testID attributes for robust testing
✓ React Native components used correctly (View, Text, TouchableOpacity, StyleSheet)
✓ MongoDB integration working for recent searches and analytics
✓ Mock data implementation follows proper structure with 8 platforms
✓ Error handling and loading states implemented correctly
✓ Expo Router navigation working across all 3 screens
✓ Deep linking templates properly configured for all 8 platforms
✓ Cache implementation (5-min TTL) reduces API load
✓ Geocode fallback working for location permission denied scenarios

test_categories.search_endpoint: ✓ POST /api/search returns 8 platforms with correct structure, sorting, and data validation
test_categories.geocode: ✓ GET /api/geocode returns city/pincode with fallback handling
test_categories.recent_searches: ✓ POST /api/recent-search and GET /api/popular-searches working with MongoDB
test_categories.edge_cases: ✓ Empty query, special characters, different pincodes handled correctly

home_screen.search_bar: ✓ Search input with placeholder visible and functional
home_screen.location_pill: ✓ Location pill with toggle functionality working
home_screen.pin_code_input: ✓ 6-digit PIN code input with validation working
home_screen.suggestion_chips: ✓ All 5 suggestion chips visible and clickable (Amul Butter, Maggi Noodles, Tata Salt, Coca-Cola, Surf Excel)

results_screen.navigation: ✓ Navigation from home to results working via suggestion chips and text input
results_screen.platform_cards: ✓ 8 platform cards displayed with correct data structure
results_screen.card_data: ✓ Each card shows: platform name, product name, price, MRP, delivery time, delivery fee, discount text
results_screen.best_badge: ✓ BEST PRICE badge displayed on cheapest option
results_screen.sort_pills: ✓ All 3 sort pills working: Best Price (default), Fastest, Best Offer
results_screen.back_button: ✓ Back button navigates to home screen

redirect_screen.navigation: ✓ Clicking platform card navigates to redirect screen
redirect_screen.display_data: ✓ Shows platform name, product name, final price, savings vs MRP, delivery time
redirect_screen.platform_branding: ✓ Platform color and initial logo displayed correctly

search_functionality.suggestion_chips: ✓ All 5 suggestion chips trigger search correctly
search_functionality.text_input: ✓ Manual text input in search bar working
search_functionality.submit: ✓ Enter key submits search and navigates to results
search_functionality.query_persistence: ✓ Search query displayed in results header

seed_data_creation: No seed data required - using built-in PRODUCT_CATALOG with 25 products
context_for_next_testing_agent: All features tested and working. Backend uses mock data for 8 platforms (Blinkit, Zepto, Swiggy, BigBasket, DMart, JioMart, Amazon, Flipkart). MongoDB integration for recent searches working. Location permission denied in web preview is expected behavior - PIN code input is the fallback.

mocked_integrations.note: MOCKED: Price scraping APIs use deterministic mock data from PRODUCT_CATALOG. POST /api/search and GET /api/search/stream return realistic but mocked prices for all 8 platforms.

additional_observations.performance: Results load with progressive reveal animation (~960ms for 8 cards at 120ms each)
additional_observations.caching: 5-minute cache TTL reduces repeated API calls for same query+pincode
additional_observations.mobile_optimization: Touch targets meet 44px minimum, proper spacing (8px grid), good contrast
additional_observations.console_warnings: Expected warnings in web preview: useNativeDriver fallback to JS animation (native module not available in web), React DevTools prompt (dev mode), package version mismatch warnings (not blocking)
